atoms.text: Ballet is a type of dance that tells stories through dance, costumes and music. It is a French word which comes from the Italian word ballare which means to dance. Ballet started in Italy during the Italian Renaissance in the 15th and 16th centuries. It spread from Italy to France where it continued to change into the dance style we know today.

Catherine de Medici was an Italian noblewoman in the 1500s. In 1533, Catherine de Medici married the French King, King Henry II and introduced the French royal courts to ballet. At the time ballet was only used to entertain aristocrats. Catherine de Medici was also responsible for bringing dance, music and poetry in ballet together in one show that followed a storyline.

text: The Royal Court is the close family and friends of the royal family and the people who work for them.
hint.label: Royal Courts

atoms.text: The Paris Ballet Company was the first ballet company and was founded by King Louis XIV. This was the beginning of ballet becoming an independent art form outside the royal courts, and it became closely associated with opera. After the Paris Ballet Company was founded, ballet began to spread all throughout Europe. The Russians had a large influence on ballet as well. The Bolshoi Ballet in Moscow, the capital of Russia, is one of the oldest still existing ballet companies in the world.
